services.desc: This type of massage is specifically tailored to your body during and after pregnancy. The goals of pre-natal and post-natal massage are similar to those of classic massage, to relax and relieve sore muscles, increase circulation and mobility, impart a sense of wellbeing, help you sleep better, and help your body and mind feel good. Pregnancy massage is performed on a massage table while lying in a side position with many cushions and pillows supporting your body and your baby for your utmost comfort.
